description: This file contains utility functions related to throughput data processing, including data rate formatting, calculation, chart data preparation, timestamp formatting, and unit conversion.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts a byte per second rate into a human-readable format with appropriate units (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps).

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates the per-second data rate for rx and tx from current and previous byte counts, handling counter resets.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a HH:MM:SS string for labeling.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares datasets and labels for chart visualization from a series of throughput data points.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the suitable unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for the y-axis based on maximum data rate present.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts data rate from bytes per second to the specified target unit.

ctags.name: convertToUnit
ctags.pattern: /^export const convertToUnit = (bytesPerSecond: number, targetUnit: string): number => {$/

ctags.name: current
ctags.pattern: /^  const rxDelta = current.rx >= previous.rx ? current.rx - previous.rx : current.rx;$/

ctags.name: current
ctags.pattern: /^  const txDelta = current.tx >= previous.tx ? current.tx - previous.tx : current.tx;$/
